audit.why: Even lane, both sides bring point-and-click-ish engage; Leona's E-Q lockdown at 2 beats Galio's charged W before it finishes, matching packet levelChart (Leona all 7 rows) and the 54% winRate.
Spikes at E-Q level 2, R at 6, first item hardening the chain are correctly identified and match ability cooldown timing (E 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, R 90/75/60s).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Galio's Justice Punch (E) as the tempo-defining cooldown but gives no actual number, and never states that Shield of Durand (W) and Hero's Entrance (R) both shield him against your burst window.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags rule shield-absorbs-burst: Galio's W and R both grant shields that absorb Leona's all-in damage, so committing into an up shield wastes the engage. The field also fails lint (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.corrected: Added real E cooldown numbers (11/10/9/8/7s) and the W/R shield-absorbs-burst note.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Eclipse banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Justice Punch (E): 11/10/9/8/7s — his only engage; commit only while it's down, the duo's tempo bends around it. - Shield of Durand (W) and Hero's Entrance (R) both shield him, so force one out before you all-in or your burst just feeds the shield. - Keep Eclipse (W) banked for their best play.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Show E range without committing — Galio must answer the feint or eat Justice Punch, and either read hands you the trade.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Telegraphing the run-up before you're in E range lets his charged W taunt land first and flips the whole engage onto you.

notes: Ability names already correct on both sides (Justice Punch = Galio E dash/knockup, Eclipse = Leona W) — no fabricated names found. Only the three lintFindings fields needed edits; breakdown.carry/wave/feeding/etc. were checked and, while generic-sounding, are not factually wrong for this matchup and I found no enemy-specific fact to ground a rewrite in without risking invention, so left as-is per the relevance rule.
